messages:
owen_partnerships: Heads-up: TradeWind SI is ready for a joint marketplace listing. Need SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning + KMS/HSM attestation validation. Can we run a quick run-through Fri 9am PT?

liz_ops: Ops can do 9am. We'll run canary in dedicated env and have rollback steps ready. Please provide metadata + attestation blob beforehand.

victor_hw: TradeWind HSM exposes PKCS#11 and an attestation endpoint at https://attest.tradewind.example/quote. I'll DM the X.509 chain and firmware hash.

kira_pm: I'll coordinate announcement timeline. Need logos and a 1-paragraph co-authored blurb by Thu noon for legal review.

owen_partnerships: Proposed SCIM mapping: userName->email, givenName->first_name, familyName->last_name, active->active. Batch size suggestion: 150 users, 2s between batches (sandbox limit 45 req/s).

liz_ops: Noted. Sandbox SCIM 45 req/s. We'll run a single-user SAML login test first, then bulk SCIM.

victor_hw: Attestation blob uploaded to Confluence. SHA256 firmware: 9f8e7d6c... Device reports TPM2 quote + cert chain.

release-bot: reminder: test snapshot scheduled Thu 22:30 PT; expect 10m maintenance.

kira_pm: Action items:
- victor_hw: confirm metadata URL + attestation (done)
- liz_ops: prepare runbook + canary deploy window
- owen_partnerships: create calendar invite + runbook link
- kira_pm: draft announcement for legal

owen_partnerships: Dry-run Fri 9am PT confirmed. Will send invite and include runbook. Locking thread unless objections.

victor_hw: All good from TradeWind side :thumbsup:

liz_ops: Ready on infra side.

kira_pm: Thanks, team.
